metadata.question: Does the built-up area east of the Nile River in Cairo increase from July 1984 to September 2019?

data.raw_code: The user wants to analyze built-up area changes east of the Nile River in Cairo from July 1984 to September 2019. This requires: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: East of Nile River in Cairo (need to define a polygon) - Time periods: July 1984 and September 2019 - Data: Landsat for built-up area detection (Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8 for 2019) - Built-up detection: Can use NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) or other urban indices 2. **Masking Strategy**: Need cloud masking for optical data 3. **Logic**: Compare built-up area between two time periods, check for valid data For built-up area, I'll use NDBI = (SWIR - NIR)/(SWIR + NIR) - Landsat 5: SWIR = B5, NIR = B4 - Landsat 8: SWIR = B6, NIR = B5 I need to define a geometry east of the Nile in Cairo and process both time periods. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometry - area east of Nile River in Cairo const geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [31.25, 30.05], [31.35, 30.05], [31.35, 30.10], [31.25, 30.10], [31.25, 30.05] ]); // Function to mask clouds for Landsat function maskLandsatClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 3; const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 4; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NDBI for built-up area function calculateNDBI(image) { const ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); // For Landsat 5 return image.addBands(ndbi); } function calculateNDBI_L8(image) { const ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDBI'); // For Landsat 8 return image.addBands(ndbi); } // Process 1984 data (Landsat 5) const col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('1984-07-01', '1984-07-31') .map(maskLandsatClouds) .map(calculateNDBI); // Process 2019 data (Landsat 8) const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate('2019-09-01', '2019-09-30') .map(maskLandsatClouds) .map(calculateNDBI_L8); // Check collection sizes const size1984 = col1984.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); print(`1984 Images: ${size1984}, 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size1984 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Get median composites const img1984 = col1984.median().select('NDBI'); const img2019 = col2019.median().select('NDBI'); // Calculate built-up area (NDBI > 0 indicates built-up) const builtup1984 = img1984.gt(0); const builtup2019 = img2019.gt(0); // Count built-up pixels const count1984 = builtup1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI'); const count2019 = builtup2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI'); const pixelCount1984 = count1984.getInfo(); const pixelCount2019 = count2019.getInfo(); print(`1984 Built-up Pixels: ${pixelCount1984}`); print(`2019 Built-up Pixels: ${pixelCount2019}`); if (pixelCount1984 === 0 || pixelCount2019 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Calculate percentage change const changePercent = ((pixelCount2019 - pixelCount1984) / pixelCount1984 * 100); print(`Change: ${changePercent.toFixed(1)}%`); // Validate result if (changePercent === null || !isFinite(changePercent) || changePercent < -100 || changePercent > 10000) { print("C3"); } else if (changePercent > 0) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
